```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API Spec Cache
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regenerate-sonar-api-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: "pnpm"
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9.4.0
          run_install: true
      - name: Exchange workflow token for GitHub App token
        id: octo-sts
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: airbytehq/airbyte
          scope: repo
          policy: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "repos:read",
                    "contents:write",
                    "pullrequests:write"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "*"
                }
              ]
            }
      - name: Run prepare-embedded-api-spec script
        run: |
          node scripts/prepare-embedded-api-spec.js
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.octo-sts.outputs.token }}
      - name: Format with Prettier
        run: |
          npx prettier --write docs/sonar-api-spec.json
      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.octo-sts.outputs.token }}
          commit-message: "docs: update sonar api spec"
          title: "docs: update sonar api spec"
          body: |
            Auto-generated PR to update the Sonar API spec.
            
            This PR was automatically generated to keep the documentation in sync with the upstream Sonar API.
          branch: "update-sonar-api-spec"
          labels: |
            auto-merge
            autogenerated
            documentation
          delete-branch: true
```
